Everything here is unmodified, taken from npm registry tarballs. Nothing is fetched from the internet when it runs:
the Reader (reader/ocr.js) points workerPath, corePath and langPath at these files and switches the library's own
cache off.

tesseract.esm.min.js, worker.min.js
  npm package tesseract.js 7.0.0 (https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js/-/tesseract.js-7.0.0.tgz), dist/.
  Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.md.
  The builds bundle these (the first four are named in worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt; the rest are the package's
  dependencies, licences as declared in their npm packages):
    regenerator-runtime  MIT
    buffer               MIT
    ieee754              BSD-3-Clause
    zlib.js              MIT
    idb-keyval           Apache-2.0
    wasm-feature-detect  Apache-2.0
    bmp-js               MIT
    is-url               MIT

core/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js, core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js, core/tesseract-core-relaxedsimd-lstm.wasm.js
  npm package tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js-core/-/tesseract.js-core-7.0.0.tgz).
  The version tesseract.js 7.0.0 asks for ("tesseract.js-core": "^7.0.0"; npm's "latest" tag points at 6.1.2, a
  later patch of the older line). Apache-2.0, see core/LICENSE. Tesseract OCR and Leptonica compiled to
  WebAssembly (Tesseract: Apache-2.0; Leptonica: BSD-2-Clause). Three builds of the recogniser (LSTM only); the
  worker picks one by what the browser's WebAssembly can do. Only one is downloaded.

lang/eng.traineddata.gz
  English, from npm package @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0
  (https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/eng/-/eng-1.0.0.tgz), folder 4.0.0_best_int: the integer version
  of "tessdata_best" (https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best), LSTM only. 2,952,873 bytes (5,199,098
  unpacked). The trained data is Apache-2.0 (lang/LICENSE, from tessdata_best); the npm package that carries it
  declares MIT.
  sha256 of the unpacked data: 5dc5d8d640a212c9d6184921ba103b186f50e0fed9ee716c53e6b312b400d747
